title: Identification of high-risk factors associated with mortality at 1-, 3-, and 5-year intervals in gastric cancer patients undergoing radical surgery and immunotherapy: an 8-year multicenter retrospective analysis.
summary: Machine-learning analysis of multicenter cohorts identified mortality risk factors after gastric-cancer surgery and immunotherapy, with external validation; the retrospective result does not establish treatment effects.
ai_technology: Machine-learning analysis of multicenter clinical cohorts identified mortality-associated factors after gastric-cancer surgery and immunotherapy, with external validation.
